Labour (2) April 28, 1934.

C.M.S.N. Co. - ex-cabin boys of s.s. "Kiangziang"
to be reinstated

In compliance with the request of the China
Merchants Steam Navigation Company, the Shanghai Branch
of the Chung Hwa Seamen's General Labour Union, 33 Oong
Ka Ts Loong, City, has notified the ex-cabin boys of
the s.s. "Kiangziang" (江靖) to register with the
Company for re-employment. This vessel is now under
repair and will be put into service next month.

Shanghai Municipality Tea Leaf Preparing Trade
Association - meeting

Some 20 members of the above association met in
their office, Lane 177 (Ching Shing Li), 47 Tsepoo Road
between 4.30 p.m. and 6 p.m. April 26 and decided to
discuss with the workers' union in the tea leaf preparing
trade the problem of reducing the workers' wages owing
to trade depression.

Tseng Tai Rubber Factory - dismissed workers to
receive gratuities

It is learned that the ex-workers of the Tseng Tai
Rubber Factory numbering some 120 will proceed to the
Doong Zung (同仁) Lawyers Office, legal advisor of the
Factory, 137 Peking Road, at about 10 a.m. April 28 with
a view to receiving their retiring gratuities. This
concern which is situated at 38 Dalny Road, closed down
at the Chinese new year owing to business depression and
formally reopened on April 7, 1934.

招商局轮船公司——“江靖”轮前侍役复职事宜

应招商局轮船公司之请求，位于本市翁家弄33号的中华海员总工会上海分会已通知“江靖”轮（江靖）的前侍役向该公司登记以谋求复职。该船目前正在进行修理，将于下月投入运营。

上海市茶叶整理业同业公会——会议

上述公会的约20名成员于4月26日下午4时30分至6时之间，在乍浦路47号庆兴里177弄的公会办事处集会，决定就因行业萧条而降低工人工资的问题，与茶叶整理业的工会进行商讨。

曾泰橡胶厂——被解雇工人领取遣散费

据悉，曾泰橡胶厂约120名前工人将于4月28日上午10时左右前往北京路137号的同仁律师事务所（该厂法律顾问），以领取其退休遣散费。该厂位于大连路38号，因业务萧条于农历新年期间停业，并于1934年4月7日正式复工。

Labour

Tseng Tai Rubber Factory - ex-workers fined
The 13 ex-workers of the Tseng Tai Rubber Factory,
38 Dalny Road, who were arrested by the Municipal Police
on April 5 for intimidation and malicious damage in
the factory (Vide I.R. 6/4/34) appeared on remand before
the Shanghai Special District Court on April 18, when they
were each fined $10.00.

Shipping Hong Coolies - strike called off
The 80 coolies of the eight shipping hongs situated in
the Settlement and French Concession who refused to transport
cotton yarn to wharves on April 2 (Vide I.R. of March 30-
April 3, 1934) resumed work on April 19. The strike was
staged as a protest against the abolition by their employers
of the transportation gratuity system under which they
were paid $0.10 to $0.30 for each package of cotton yarn
transported to wharves and was called off on the shipping
hongs concerned promising the restoration of the payment.

General Labour Union - meeting
Seven committee members of the General Labour Union
held a meeting in their office at 117 Foh You Road, City, at
3 p.m. April 18 and decided to inform all labour unions that
all participants in the labourers' athletic meeting should
forward their application together with a photograph so as
to prevent persons other than labourers from taking part.

曾泰橡胶厂——前工人被罚款
曾泰橡胶厂（大连路38号）的13名前工人，因在工厂内实施恐吓和恶意破坏于4月5日被工部局警察逮捕（参见1934年4月6日调查报告），于4月18日在上海特区法院受审，每人被罚款10.00元。

航运商号苦力——罢工取消
位于租界和法租界的八家航运商号的80名苦力，曾于4月2日拒绝将棉纱运往码头（参见1934年3月30日至4月3日的调查报告），于4月19日复工。此次罢工是为了抗议雇主废除运输津贴制度，根据该制度，每运送一包棉纱至码头可获得0.10至0.30元的报酬；由于相关航运商号承诺恢复该项支付，罢工得以取消。

总工会——会议
总工会的七名委员于4月18日下午3时在本市福州路117号的办事处举行会议，决定通知所有工会，凡参加劳工运动会的参与者均需提交申请及照片，以防止非劳工人员参加。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

The accused appeared before the S. S. D. Court on the 6/4/34 and the case remanded for one week during which the accused could be released on each furnishing $30.00. cash or shop security. The necessary security was furnished on the 9-4-34.

During the period of remand unsuccessful efforts were made to locate the three ex-employees named Tseng Kyung Sung, Wong Kuang Nyoen and Ho Kyung Kung, who were responsible for illegally detaining the two present employees Zee San Pau and Zee Pao Sung, and it would appear that they have left the district for the meantime.

As none of the other employees at the Complainant's factory are willing to come forward and testify against the accused regarding the Intimidation charge, a further charge of Trespass has now been preferred. The Police will be able to testify as to this charge.

The chief reason why no more witnesses can be obtained to give evidence against the accused, on the two original charges, is because the management themselves have somewhat changed their attitude on the matter, and now are not anxious to show a strong hand policy for fear of creating an unfavourable impression amongst the workmen who they fear might side with the trouble makers.

page_data.en:
At 4.10.p.m. on April 5, a telephone message was
received from C.D.C.325 on duty at the Tsung Tai
Rubber Factory, 38 Dalny Road, to the effect that a
number of workmen recently dismissed from the said
factory had made their way into the above premises and
were intimidating the employees.

A posse of police under S.I. McCahey immediately
attended and later brought to the station thirteen
of these ex-employees who were arrested by F.S.161
Muir, C.D.S,s 11, 98, C.D.C,s 114, 377 and 325, prior
to their arrival. F.S. Muir and the mentioned detec-
tives had been detailed for duty at the above factory,
as it was more or less anticipated that ex-employees
would create trouble of some nature when the above
factory commenced work to-day after having been closed
since the 7-2-34 on account of mismanagement coupled
with the effects of the present industrial depression.

Subsequent enquiries carried out by the under-
signed, D.I. Seo Tang Sung and D.S.I. Yang Pei Sheng
and it was ascertained that about 4.p.m. on the 5-4-34
Oong Joh Yoong (洪福榮) newly appointed chief engineer
of the Tsung Tai Rubber Factory, reported to C.D.S,s
11, 98 and C.D.C.114, 377 and 325 who were on duty
at the main entrance to the Factory, that a number of
dismissed employees had gained entry into the factory
by way of a back door which had been opened by a
carpenter in connection with repairs he was carrying
out at the factory.
page_data.zh:
4月5日下午4时10分，值班于大连路38号曾泰橡胶厂的 C.D.C.325 打来电话，称一些近期被该厂解雇的工人已进入上述场所，并正在恐吓雇员。

由 McCahey 高级巡官率领的一队警察立即赶赴现场，随后将其中十三名前雇员带回警局，这些人在警察到达之前已被 F.S.161 Muir、C.D.S,s 11, 98、C.D.C,s 114, 377 和 325 逮捕。F.S. Muir 和上述侦探被派往该厂执勤，因为人们或多或少预料到，该厂自1934年2月7日因管理不善加上当前工业萧条的影响而关闭后，今日复工时前雇员会制造某种麻烦。

经下述人员、侦探 Seo Tang Sung 和副督察 Yang Pei Sheng 进行的后续调查，查明在1934年4月5日下午4时许，曾泰橡胶厂新任命的首席工程师 Oong Joh Yoong (洪福榮) 向在工厂正门值勤的 C.D.S,s 11, 98 和 C.D.C.114, 377 及 325 报告称，一些被解雇的雇员通过一扇后门进入工厂，该后门是由一名在工厂进行维修工作的木匠打开的。

page_data.en:
Immediately after gaining entry these ex-employees
set about damaging a machine used for the manufacture of
rubber shoes. The damage is estimated at $300. On leav-
ing a few of these ex-employees, not at present under
arrest, also seized hold of two present employees named
Zee San Pau (徐三宝) and Zee Pao Sung (徐宝生) and forced
them to accompany them. These two incidents had occurred
before the Police were summoned to intervene, however, the
thirteen ex-employees were arrested in the factory, the
remainder of them succeeding in making good their escape.

Regarding the two persons who were taken away by
force, they were released at about 7.45.p.m. even date
when they returned to the factory. According to these
two employees statements, after being forcibly taken from
the factory, they were escorted by four men first to No.
672 Sing Ts Lee of Dalny Road, where they remained for
approx. 15 minutes, prior to being escorted to a bath
house at Ward Road, by three of the four original escorts
named Tseng Kyung Sung (盛金生), Wong Kuang Nyoon and Ho
Kyung Kang (馬金根). The fourth man who acted as escort
is unknown to these two employees. After having remained
in the bath house for roughly one hour, they were again
taken to a house at Kinshew Road which is occupied by a
present employed workman at the factory, named Yee San
(俞三宝). He was not at home at the time, and Tseng Kyung
page_data.zh:
这些前雇员进入后立即着手损坏一台用于制造橡胶鞋的机器。损失估计为300元。离开时，几名目前未被逮捕的前雇员还挟持了两名现任雇员，名为 Zee San Pau (徐三宝) 和 Zee Pao Sung (徐宝生)，并强迫他们随行。这两起事件发生在警察被召来干预之前，然而，十三名前雇员在工厂内被捕，其余人则成功逃脱。

关于被强行带走的两人，他们在当日晚上7时45分左右返回工厂时被释放。根据这两名雇员的陈述，被强行带离工厂后，他们先由四人护送至大连路672号 Sing Ts Lee，在那里停留了约15分钟，随后由原四名护送者中的三人，即 Tseng Kyung Sung (盛金生)、Wong Kuang Nyoon 和 Ho Kyung Kang (馬金根)，护送至华德路的一家浴室。第四名护送者这两名雇员并不认识。在浴室停留约一小时后，他们又被带到锦秀路的一所房屋，该房屋由工厂的一名现任工人 Yee San (俞三宝) 居住。当时他不在家，Tseng Kyung

page_data.en:
Sung alone kept guard over them, his two associates parting
with him at the bath house. At about 7.45.p.m. even date
these two employees were left unguarded by Tseng Kyung Sung
so they took advantage of the situation and made good their
escape and returned to their place of employment, from
where they were brought to the station for enquiries by
D...I. Yang Pei Sheng. During the whole time they were
unlawfully detained the two employees, assert that they were
not threatened or ill treated in anyway, and were not even
approached regarding the incident leading up to their
detention. This would tend to point that these guards were
merely acting on instructions of some higher authority, and
that the affair was carefully prearranged.

It is also significant to point out at this juncture
that a lawyer Woo Kay Sung (吴凯声) telephoned D.I. Soo Zang
Sung at about 7.15.p.m. even date and asked the latter if
some of his clients were in custody in connection with the
disturbance at the Rubber Factory at Dalny Road this after-
noon. D.I. Soo answered in the affirmative and told lawyer
Woo that two of the employees were forcibly taken away by
his clients, and unless they were released right away a
serious view would have to be taken of the matter. Soo
promised to get in touch with the spokesmen of the ex-employ-
ees, hence the release of these two employees about half
an hour subsequent to the above telephone conversation.

All these thirteen ex-employees have been charged with
page_data.zh:
宋某独自看守他们，他的两名同伙在澡堂与他分手。同日晚上约7时45分，曾庆宋（Tseng Kyung Sung）未对这两名雇员进行看守，他们便利用这一情况成功逃脱，并返回其工作地点，随后由洋探员杨培生（Yang Pei Sheng）将他们带至警局接受问询。在整个被非法拘禁期间，这两名雇员声称他们未受到任何形式的威胁或虐待，甚至无人就导致其被拘禁的事件与他们接触。这似乎表明这些看守者 merely 是在执行某些上级当局的指令，且此事是经过精心预谋的。

在此刻指出以下情况也具有重要意义：律师吴凯声（Woo Kay Sung）于同日晚上约7时15分致电洋探员苏章宋（Soo Zang Sung），询问后者是否有一些他的客户因今天下午大连路（Dalny Road）橡胶厂骚乱一事而被拘留。苏探员给予肯定答复，并告诉吴律师，有两名雇员被其客户强行带走，除非立即释放他们，否则当局将不得不严肃看待此事。苏承诺与前雇员的代表取得联系，因此在上述通话后约半小时，这两名雇员获释。

所有这十三名前雇员均被指控

page_data.en:
Intimidation and Malicious Damage, and the 2nd accused
identified
by one of the detained employees named Lee Bau Sung as
one of the persons who actually pushed him out of the
factory. This accused is also identified by another
employee, Sung Yeng Sung as having attempted to forcibly
remove him from the factory. None of the other accused
have been identified by either of these two employees
from whom statements have been taken.

Accused will appear before the Court on the 6-4-34,
and a remand of one week will be requested with a view to
making further arrest in the case.

Q. Turner,
D.S.I.

D.D.C. "D"

恐吓和恶意破坏，其中第二名被告被一名被拘留的雇员李宝宋（Lee Bau Sung）指认为实际将其推出工厂的人员之一。另一名雇员宋英宋（Sung Yeng Sung）也指认该被告曾试图强行将其带离工厂。这两名已取供的雇员均未指认其他任何被告。

被告将于1934年4月6日出庭受审，并将申请还押一周，以便在该案中进行进一步逮捕。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5780
Date 12 / 4 / 34
137 Peking Road,
Shanghai, China,
3rd April 1934.

Urgent.

Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Police.

Dear Sir,

On behalf of our clients, the Tsung Tai Rubber
Factory (正泰橡膠廠) of No. 38 Dalny Road, we beg to lay
before you the facts leading to a disturbance recently
created by the workers at their factory and request
your kind assistance at the reopening of the factory by its
successors, the Tsung Tai Sing Kee Rubber Factory
(正泰信記橡膠廠) which will takeplace on the 5th inst.

The Tsung Tai Rubber Factory is a partnership
concern established several years ago. In the first few
years they made a good profit all of which was added to
their capital. Since the fire in the early part of last
year at the No.1 Factory on the Tongshan Road, the partnership
suffered considerable losses, but it was still in solvent
state until the beginning of this year when the partners
found that the factory was heavily indebted and in a
bankruptcy condition. After setting off all the assets
there remained a total sum of four and half laks due
to the various banks. In these circumstances they were
compelled to wind up their business and had their account
books investigated by chartered accountants. In the mean-
while they gave notice to the works to that effect. The old
factory had about 700 workers in all, amongst whom 500
were female workers and the rest were male workers. All
the female workers were on piece job basis but the male
workers were paid monthly. In order to terminate the service
of the male workers our clients paid two months extra wages
each. The female workers were not paid any compensation

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
编号 D 5780
日期 1934年4月12日
中国上海北京路137号
1934年4月3日

急件。

致：
上海公共租界工部局警务处处长

尊敬的先生：

谨代表我们的客户——大连路38号正泰橡胶厂（Tsung Tai Rubber Factory），向阁下陈述近期该厂工人制造骚乱的事实经过，并恳请阁下协助该厂的继任者正泰信记橡胶厂（Tsung Tai Sing Kee Rubber Factory）于本月5日重新开工。

正泰橡胶厂是一家数年前成立的合伙企业。在最初的几年里，他们获利颇丰，所有利润均计入资本。自去年年初通山路（Tongshan Road）第一工厂发生火灾以来，该合伙企业遭受了重大损失，但直到今年年初仍具备偿债能力；此时合伙人发现工厂负债累累，处于破产状态。抵销所有资产后，仍欠各家银行总计四万五千两。在这种情况下，他们被迫停业清算，并由特许会计师查账。同时，他们向工厂发布了相关通知。旧工厂共有约700名工人，其中500名为女工，其余为男工。所有女工均按计件工资制领取薪水，而男工则按月领薪。为了终止男工的雇佣关系，我们的客户额外支付了每人两个月的工资。女工未获得任何赔偿，

page_data.en:
-2-
according to Chinese Law on the ground that they were
on piece job basis.

From the above you will see that our clients have
been treating the workers in a most reasonable manner.
Unfortunately among those workers there are a number of
agitators who led a number of workers, about 700 in number,
and rushed into the Factory on the morning of the 22nd
ult. broke the window glass of the accounting office,
helped themselves to rob the food prepared for the staff
and assaulted the employees in the accounting office.
Their excuse for doing so was that they were starving and
insisted that the Factory should be reopened forthwith.
Fortunately the Police Officers of the Yulin Road Station
arrived at the spot just in time to stop further trouble.
Had they arrived a few minutes later the whole factory would
have been smashed or damaged. Our clients especially ask
us to take this opportunity to express their sincere thanks
for the good services rendered.

The old Factory was unable to carry on the business any
further as they have leased the whole property to the present
successor the Tsung Tai Sing Kee Rubber Factory. One of the
terms of the lease is that the old workers shall have a
prior right to employment. Notice to that effect was published
in the newspapers by the new Factory, requesting the old workers
to register their names within three days, that is to say
from the 28th to the 31st ult. Although most of the workers
were willing to register their names with the new Factory,
however they were prevented from doing so by the agitators
who were watching in the vicinity of the Factory, threatening
everyone who desired to register with violence. The matter
page_data.zh:
-2-
理由是根据中国法律，她们属于计件工。

从上述情况可以看出，我们的客户一直以最为合理的方式对待工人。不幸的是，在这些工人中有一些煽动者，他们带领约700名工人，于上月22日上午冲进工厂，打碎会计处的窗玻璃，抢走为职员准备的食物，并殴打会计处的雇员。他们这样做的借口是声称自己正在挨饿，并坚持要求工厂立即复工。幸运的是，榆林路警局的警官及时赶到现场，制止了事态进一步扩大。如果他们晚到几分钟，整个工厂可能会被砸毁或损坏。我们的客户特别要求我们借此机会表达他们对警方提供良好服务的诚挚谢意。

由于旧工厂已将全部财产租赁给目前的继任者正泰信记橡胶厂，因此无法继续经营。租赁条款之一是旧工人拥有优先受雇权。新工厂在报纸上刊登了相关通知，要求旧工人在三天内，即上月28日至31日登记姓名。虽然大多数工人愿意向新工厂登记姓名，但他们受到在工厂附近监视的煽动者的阻挠，这些煽动者以暴力威胁每一个想要登记的人。此事

page_data.en:
-3-

was reported to the Yulin Road Station, and with the
latter's assistance about 50 male workers were able to
complete their registration and are now in the new
Factory's employment. The new Factory has also published
a notice to reopen on the 5th instant. The working
time is from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Being afraid that the
reopening day may be marked by further disturbances and
that the small force at the Yulin Road Station may not
be sufficient to cope with the situation they venture to
request that you would be good enough to arrange for
the necessary protection to the legal workers on opening
day and thereafter for a few days.

Thanking you in anticipation.

We are, Sir,

Yours faithfully,

(Sd) Feng & Co.
page_data.zh:
-3-

已报告给榆林路警局，并在该局的协助下，约50名男工完成了登记，目前已在新的工厂就业。新工厂还发布公告，定于本月5日复工。工作时间为上午7时至下午7时。由于担心复工当天可能会发生进一步的骚乱，且榆林路警局警力不足难以应付局势，故冒昧请求阁下惠予安排，在复工当天及随后几天为合法工人提供必要的保护。

预先致谢。

此致，

敬礼，

（签名）冯氏律师事务所（Feng & Co.）

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.

April Date 7. 4. 34

Labour

Tseng Tai Rubber Factory - formally reopened

The Tseng Tai Rubber Factory, 38 Dalny Road, which closed down at the Chinese New Year owing to business depression formally reopened this morning, April 7.

On April 6, the management issued a notice dealing with the conduct expected of workers, the method of calculating wages and scales of payment for shoes made which ranges from 2.5 to 5 cents per pair.

At 10.30 a.m. April 6, a delegate of the Bureau of Social Affairs visited the factory for the purpose of investigating a report that the management have failed to issue the annual bonus to its employees for 1932 and 1933. It was eventually ascertained that the report was untrue.

The thirteen Chinese who were arrested by the Police on April 5 for causing disturbances in the factory (Vide I.R. 6/4/34) were brought before the Court on April 6 and were remanded one week.

China Wire Products Company - Intimidation by dismissed employee

On April 5, a smith in the employ of the China Wire Products Company, 650 Juming Road, was dismissed for incompetence. This worker carried out intimidation among other employees outside the concern with the result that half of them failed to turn up on the evening shift. None of the employees, numbering 45, put in an appearance at the factory on April 6, but resumed work this morning, April 7.

劳工事务

正泰橡胶厂 - 正式复工

位于大连路38号的正泰橡胶厂因商业萧条于农历新年期间关闭，于今晨（4月7日）正式复工。

4月6日，管理层发布了一则通告，涉及对工人行为的要求、工资计算方法以及所制鞋类的计件工资标准，范围为每双2.5至5分。

4月6日上午10时30分，社会局代表访问该厂，旨在调查有关管理层未向其雇员发放1932年和1933年度年终奖金的报告。经最终查证，该报告不实。

4月5日因在工厂制造骚乱而被警方逮捕的十三名中国人（参见1934年4月6日情报报告）于4月6日被提审，并被还押一周。

中国五金制品厂 - 被解雇员工的恐吓行为

4月5日，居明路（Juming Road）650号中国五金制品厂的一名铁匠因不胜任工作被解雇。该工人在厂外对其他员工进行恐吓，导致半数员工未在晚班出勤。4月6日，全厂45名员工无一出现在工厂，但于今晨（4月7日）恢复工作。

April 6th, 1934

Labour (3)

Tseng Tai Rubber Factory - Agitation of ex-workers

At 3.50 p.m. April 5, while the workers were engaged
in making arrangements for resumption of operation, some
30 Chinese males who are believed to be ex-employees
entered the Tseng Tai Rubber Factory, 38 Dalny Road by a
side door and damaged a machine as well as a quantity of
material. The Municipal Police arrived on the scene and
succeeded in apprehending thirteen of their number. These
persons will be arraigned before the Court this morning,
April 6. It is reported that the disturbances was created
at the instigation of Tang Zu-yuen (湯世源) and Tsiang
Ah-san (阿三), who are ex-workers of the factory.

During the trouble two workers named Zee San Pao
(徐三寶) and Zee Pao Sung (徐寶生) were taken away
from the factory and confined in a house at Kinchow Road
which is occupied by a worker named Yue San Pao (俞三寶)
who is at present in the employ of the factory. They
however succeeded in making their escape at 7.45 p.m.
the same day when they were left unguarded.

This concern remains open this morning with some
260 workers continuing to make arrangements for resumption
of work.

Umbrella Makers in Shanghai - strike situation

The strike of local umbrella makers continues this
morning, April 6.

1934年4月6日

劳工事务 (3)

正泰橡胶厂 - 前工人的煽动活动

4月5日下午3时50分，当工人们正在安排恢复生产事宜时，约30名据信为前雇员的华籍男子通过侧门进入大连路38号正泰橡胶厂，损坏了一台机器及一批材料。公共租界巡捕赶到现场，成功抓获其中十三人。这些人将于今晨（4月6日）出庭受审。据报道，此次骚乱是由该厂前工人汤世源（Tang Zu-yuen）和阿三（Tsiang Ah-san）唆使制造的。

在骚乱期间，两名名为徐三宝（Zee San Pao）和徐宝生（Zee Pao Sung）的工人被带离工厂，并拘禁在金州路（Kinchow Road）的一栋房屋内，该房屋由目前在厂任职的工人俞三宝（Yue San Pao）居住。然而，他们在同日晚上7时45分趁无人看守之机成功逃脱。

今晨该企业仍在运营，约260名工人继续安排复工事宜。

上海伞匠 - 罢工情况

今晨（4月6日），本地伞匠的罢工仍在继续。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 5780
Date 4 / 4 / 34

April 4, 4.

Labour (5)

Chai Lung Silk Weaving Factory - strike

Twenty workers of the Chai Lung Silk Weaving
Factory, Lane 455, Nos.9-13 Pingliang Road, declared a
strike at 1 p.m. March 30 to enforce a demand for the
restoration of the former rate of pay, i.e., 5 cents per
yard of silk woven. They, however, resumed unconditionally
this morning, April 4. These hands are now paid 4.5
cents per yard of silk woven.

Tseng Tai No.2 Rubber Factory - distribution of handbills

In the morning of April 3, copies of a handbill
entitled a "Manifesto issued by the workers of the Tseng
Tai Rubber Factory to oppose the reorganization and the
dismissal of employees as well as the reduction in wages"
were distributed in the Eastern District. The handbill
apart from denouncing the management for oppressing
the workers, contains the following demands :-

1. Oppose the registration of workers.
2. Oppose the reduction in wages.
3. Oppose the dismissal of workers.
4. Demand that the bonus for the past three years be
given to the workers.
5. Demand that all workers be reinstated with
the former rate of pay.

蔡隆丝织厂 - 罢工

平凉路455弄9-13号蔡隆丝织厂的二十名工人于3月30日下午1时宣布罢工，以强制要求恢复以前的工资率，即每码丝绸织品5分。然而，他们于今晨（4月4日）无条件复工。目前这些工人的工资为每码丝绸织品4.5分。

正泰第二橡胶厂 - 散发传单

4月3日上午，东区散发了题为《正泰橡胶厂工人反对改组、解雇员工及减薪宣言》的传单副本。该传单除了谴责管理层压迫工人外，还包含以下要求：

1. 反对工人登记。
2. 反对减薪。
3. 反对解雇工人。
4. 要求向工人发放过去三年的奖金。
5. 要求所有工人复职并恢复原有工资率。

Labour Trouble.

At 9.50 a.m. 22-3-54 a telephone message was received
from the Tsung Tai Rubber Factory, Dalny Road reporting
trouble with workers.

Inspector Shellswell, D.I. Thurgood and a party of
police attended and from enquiries made it was ascertained
that the above factory has been closed since 9-2-54 as a
result of heavy financial loss caused chiefly through bad
management. It has been the practice of the company to
provide 174 male employees with wages and two meals a day
at 10 a.m. and 5 p.m. whilst the factory has been closed.

At 9.50 a.m. 22-3-54 a large number of male and female
workers went to the factory and demanded food, but were
informed by a factory detective that the management would
not provide food in future. A quarrel arose between workers
and detective and later developed into a fight during which
a female worker named Ts Lieu Sz received a cut on the wrist
and alleged that the factory detective had stabbed her with
a knife. Sent to Sacred Heart Hospital and treated for
incised wound of right forearm, not serious, not detained.
No witnesses could be found who saw the assault. Compt. did
not wish to charge.

At 12.30 p.m. 22-3-54 the workers began to get restless
and refused to leave the compound of the factory, so were
quietly cleared by the police. Nothing untoward occurred.
Police have been posted in the vicinity in the event of further
trouble. For full details see Misc. 54/34 Yulin Road.

1934年3月22日上午9时50分，接大连路宗泰橡胶厂电话报告，称发生工人骚乱。

Shellswell巡官、Thurgood副巡官及一队警员前往处理，经查询获悉，上述工厂自1934年2月9日起因主要由于管理不善造成严重财务亏损而关闭。在工厂关闭期间，公司惯例是向174名男性雇员提供工资以及每日上午10时和下午5时的两餐伙食。

1934年3月22日上午9时50分，大批男女工人前往工厂要求提供食物，但一名工厂侦探告知他们，管理层今后将不再提供食物。工人与侦探发生争吵，随后演变为斗殴，其间一名名为Ts Lieu Sz（音译）的女工手腕受伤，并指控工厂侦探用刀刺伤了她。她被送往圣心医院治疗右前臂切割伤，伤势不重，未予留院。未能找到目睹袭击事件的证人。控告人不愿提出指控。

1934年3月22日下午12时30分，工人们开始变得不安，拒绝离开工厂大院，警方遂将其quietly cleared（平稳驱散）。未发生其他意外事件。已在附近部署警力以防进一步骚乱。详情参见榆林路档案 Misc. 54/34。
